repos.description: 京东抢购自动下单助手，GUI 支持 Windows 和 macOS
repos.summary_zh: 京东小猪手是Python开发的跨平台自动抢购助手，核心功能包括7x24小时库存监听、自动下单及微信通知。支持扫码登录与预售定金模式，提供Windows/macOS图形界面，简化配置流程。采用SKU/AreaID精准定位商品与配送区域，适用于秒杀、缺货商品监控等场景，提升抢购成功率。
repos.summary_en: JdBuyer is a Python-based cross-platform automation assistant for JD.com flash sales. It provides 24/7 stock monitoring, automatic order placement, and WeChat notifications. The tool features QR code login, GUI support for Windows/macOS, and handles pre-sale deposits. Users configure SKU/AreaID for precise targeting, making it effective for seckill events and out-of-stock tracking, giving regular buyers equal opportunity against automated scalpers.

repos.summary_zh: AegisFlow 是本地运行的 GLM Coding 支付运营后台，支持多账号导入、套餐同步、腾讯验证码自动 OCR 识别与链路处理、预览下单签单生成二维码及定时任务启动。基于 FastAPI 后端与 Node.js 构建，集成内置 Python 代理池，实现全自动化支付流程，适合本地多账号管理和运营效率提升。
repos.summary_en: AegisFlow is a locally running payment operations backend for GLM Coding, supporting multi-account import/sync, automatic Tencent captcha OCR recognition and processing chains, order preview/signing for QR code generation, and scheduled task launching. Built with FastAPI backend and Node.js, featuring built-in Python proxy pool for fully automated payment workflows, ideal for local multi-account management and operational efficiency.

repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT订阅支付链路自动化研究项目，聚焦支付流程（直卡/PayPal BA/hCaptcha）的工程实现与代理对齐。基于FastAPI后端核心引擎与React前端面板，支持多代理池与接码对接，仅供学习研究使用。
repos.summary_en: Research project on automating ChatGPT subscription payment chains, covering card binding, PayPal BA flows and hCaptcha handling. Built with FastAPI backend engines and React frontend panel, integrating multi-proxy pools and SMS services for study purposes only.
